newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine bus crash kills 19, injures 39.
newsitem.headline: Philippine bus crash kills 19, injures 39.

text.p: Nineteen persons were killed and 39 injured when a passenger bus crashed into 60-metre deep ravine in a town near the southern tip of the main Luzon island, police said on Tuesday.

Town police chief Roberto Malubay said four children were among those killed after the bus lost control along a zigzag portion of the national highway in Labo town, Camarines Norte province, 210 km (130 miles) southeast of Manila, on Monday.
The bus was on its way to Manila from a nearby town.
The police are still investigating the cause of the accident, Malubay added. The driver was among those who died on the spot.
